findings.title: Feature-disabled test does not verify the documented exit code 4
findings.body: The new FEATURE_DISABLED path exits with code 4, and the update-compatibility guide documents that code as part of the scripting contract. testFeatureNotEnabled only asserts the error text, so a regression that exits with 0 or 1 would still pass. The `check` subcommand's disabled path (UpdateCompatibilityCheck.run) has no test at all. The PR also renumbers RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE from 4 to 3, and no test pins that value either.

findings.title: Exit code 4 changes meaning: recreate moved to 3 and 4 now means feature disabled
findings.body: RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE changes from 4 to 3 and FEATURE_DISABLED is introduced with the value 4. Any automation written against the code's previous behavior, which treated exit 4 as 'shut down before upgrade', will now read 'feature disabled' and react incorrectly. The PR does not mention this renumbering as a behavior change. The docs already listed 3 for recreate, so doc-following scripts are unaffected. Still, the change should be called out, since it alters an externally visible exit-code contract.

findings.title: CAUTION claims the Operator always fails without rolling-updates, which is overbroad
findings.body: The CAUTION says that without the rolling-updates feature 'the Operator will fail', without qualification. UpgradeTest.createInitialDeployment(null) builds a CR with no update strategy and no rolling-updates feature, and the image-change tests expect it to work normally. The NOTE in the same section also says the default strategy mimics 26.1 behavior. The requirement should be scoped to CRs that set spec.update, otherwise users will think every CR needs the preview feature.

findings.title: setEnabledFeatures overwrites any features already set on the CR
findings.body: The code guards `getFeatureSpec() == null` before creating a FeatureSpec, which implies the FeatureSpec may already be populated by getTestKeycloakDeployment(true). Line 115 then replaces the whole enabled-features list with an immutable List.of(ROLLING_UPDATES) rather than adding to it. Any other features the base deployment enables are silently dropped for the RECREATE and rolling-strategy variants. Merging into the existing list would avoid this.
